breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet (u=0 on all edges) and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundary conditions and only states to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u=0 on all four edges of the domain', thus fixing the inconsistency.
